title: 1999 Granada–Dakar Rally
who: Won by Jean-Louis Schlesser / Philippe Monnet (Schlesser-Renault) and Richard Sainct (BMW)
summary: The 1999 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 17 stage towns and bivouacs through Spain, Morocco, Mauritania, Mali, Burkina Faso, Senegal. Winners — Cars: Jean-Louis Schlesser / Philippe Monnet (Schlesser-Renault); Bikes: Richard Sainct (BMW); Trucks: Karel Loprais / Radomír Stachura / Josef Kalina (Tatra 815).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
